lines.en: I carry a lute up the stairs.
The strings sound before my feet land.
The stairs are narrow; I go sideways.

lines.zh: 酒馆的地板被我踩出节拍
lines.en: My steps keep time on the tavern floor.
A feather sticks from my hat.
I tune as I walk.

lines.zh: 这栋楼的木头很会传声
lines.en: This building's wood carries sound well.
I weave between the tables.
Someone's shouting below; I ignore it.
What I want is a corner.
I pass the barrels and the ale fumes rise.
I'm in no hurry to sit.
I pluck twice and stop to listen.
One string has gone old.
The goblins below hum along.
I play with my eyes closed.
The music circles the building once.
I hear someone coming up.
I didn't come to fight.
I rest a foot on the railing.
They need this tune.
I count the beats.
You came up.
Don't stand in front of my lute.
You stepped on the beat.

lines.zh: 我这首是给下面的人听的
lines.en: This one's for the ones downstairs.
You don't smell of ale.
I don't hit; I only push you.
The hat's borrowed; don't take it.
Stand back so I can see you.

lines.zh: 你在数我们有几个人吧
lines.en: You're counting how many of us there are.
This tune isn't for you.
A bit of the lute's finish came off.
That knocked my hat off.
I don't cry out; it would go off key.
Blood on my fingers; I can still play.
I steady myself on the railing.
This leg is aching again.
I check the lute; it's fine.
Don't strike my wrist.
I take a deep breath.
Gold? I'll take it, and I'll still play.
Set the ale aside.
I don't eat; I sing.
Are you requesting a song?
Requests cost coin.
This coin's poorly struck.
I'm not short on that.
Leave it and go.
That doesn't interest me.
Don't interrupt me with that.
You bumped my lute.

lines.zh: 我退开半步，换个地方弹
lines.en: I shift half a step and play elsewhere.
Don't lean on the railing.
That knocked a string out of tune.

lines.zh: 我用肩膀把你顶开一点
lines.en: I nudge you aside with a shoulder.
The floor creaks because of me.

lines.zh: 酒馆楼上的曲子，别打断。
lines.en: The tune upstairs — don't interrupt it.
I'm not angry; I just start over.

lines.zh: 站远点，我听不清自己的琴
lines.en: Stand off, I can't hear my own lute.
I make room, and you still don't leave.
My lute matters more than that.
Too many people in the tavern; not here.
I'm too old for that.

lines.zh: 楼上的角落只有我一个
lines.en: I'm the only one in this upstairs corner.
The song still gets sung.
You've interrupted my tuning.
Change the subject.
That isn't in my tune.
Quiet, listen to what's downstairs.
Ask me later.

lines.zh: 我捡起掉在地上的琴拨
lines.en: I pick up a fallen pick.
Coin should be kept safe.

lines.zh: 我弯腰的时候帽子会掉
lines.en: My hat falls off when I bend.
I scoop up what falls.
This isn't mine.
I tuck it into my hat.
This could serve as a pick.
That string on the floor is mine.
Waste not.
I pick it up and play a bit livelier.
Someone's broken in.

lines.zh: 上楼的脚步不是哥布林
lines.en: These steps up the stairs aren't goblins.
My lute has stopped.

lines.zh: 下面的人还在唱，我先看这边
lines.en: They're still singing below; I look here first.
This one's at the stairhead.
I press the strings and wait for a note.
First, I stand up.
I'll save this note as a signal.
Close enough that I can push.
He's carrying something.
There's only one window up here.
He turned his back to the stairs.
This one, I handle myself.
I won't call anyone.
I take one step forward.
This corner is mine.
One step closer and I push.
The lute still sounds, but slower.
I don't hit; I push.
That board under you will creak.
I'm right at the stairs.
Don't go toward the window.
I hold the lute to my chest.
The song below goes on, and so do I.

lines.zh: 我这条腿撑得住一会儿
lines.en: This leg will hold a while.
I stop playing this part.

lines.zh: 你站在我原来的位置上
lines.en: You're standing where I stood.
My hands are free now.
One step more and you'll touch the lute.
I won't shout; it does no good.
This stair fits one at a time.
I see you gripping the railing.
I take half a step forward.

lines.zh: 这段曲子，楼上的都听得见。
lines.en: Upstairs can hear this tune.
I push your chest with a palm.
My shoulder meets you, and you back.
The lute comes across as a barrier.
Not heavy, but enough to move you.
I don't pursue; I only push.
You strike the railing.
I push you toward the stairs.
The strings give a strange cry.
Come up again and I'll push again.
I step back and steady the lute.
That one hurt my hand too.

lines.zh: 我不出拳，那不是我的事
lines.en: I don't throw punches; that isn't my part.

lines.zh: 你脚下的板裂了一条缝
lines.en: The board under you split.
I pen you at the stairhead.
You went back three steps.
I hold the railing and catch my breath.
The lute still hangs from my arm.
Try again and I'll use my foot.
I stop and step back.

lines.zh: 楼上那把椅子空着，我坐上去
lines.en: The chair upstairs was empty; I sit in it.
The music leaks out the window first.
I stand at the stairhead holding my lute.
The people in the tavern look up.
I came in the back door.
This building has a song tonight.
I set the lute right and pluck once.

lines.zh: 下面的哥布林已经聚起来了
lines.en: The goblins below have gathered.
My hat hangs on a nail.
I know these stairs well.
The wind outside stirs the curtain.
I won't go to the roof; here is fine.
When fire comes, the lute suffers first.

lines.zh: 酒泼了我一身，跟淹了差不多
lines.en: Ale soaked me; near enough to drowning.
The blast drowned out the lute.

lines.zh: 箭钉在栏杆上，离我半尺
lines.en: The arrow stuck in the railing, half a foot away.
The spell hit and the strings rang by themselves.
Too hungry to sing.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我整把琴都响了
lines.en: Lightning struck and the whole lute rang.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有回声，很难唱
lines.en: No echo in the void; hard to sing.
